Gym Rat.name: Gym Rat
Gym Rat.description:
🏋️ You lived at the gym after school.

💪 Weights and a heavy bag were your daily routine.
📓 You kept a training log and never skipped it.

📈 Grants: Conditioning +5, Striking +5
Gym Rat.traitNarrativeEffects: The character kept a strict training routine through high school and still does: early workouts, protein, rest days counted. They are hard to tire and know how to hit; they get restless when a day has no training.
